head.title: FLOW 2: CUSTOMER PURCHASE FLOW - Khách mua hàng (Tích hợp LMfWC)

outline._note: Admin quản lý licenses, devices, pools, accounts, logs và analytics. Tất cả thao tác qua WordPress Admin Dashboard.
Các chức năng admin có thể làm

outline.text: 1. License Management: View/search licenses, view details, view devices, manage device status
2. Device Management: View all devices, remove/block/unblock devices, view device history
3. Pool Management: View/add/edit/delete pools, view pool capacity, reassign licenses
4. Account Management: View/add/edit/delete provider accounts, update credentials
5. Logs & Analytics: View access logs, request history, analytics dashboard, reports
6. Settings: Product share configs, VPS settings, IP whitelist
Shop Manager: View licenses, manage devices, view logs
Customer: Chỉ access portal (không vào admin)
